transcript: Speaker A: आप ट्रेन से कहां जा रही हैं? [Where are you going by train?] Speaker B: I going Delhi attend wedding. Speaker A: इसे ऐसे बोलिए, I am going to Delhi to attend a wedding. [Say it like this, I am going to Delhi to attend a wedding.] Speaker B: मुझे सेंटेंस बनाना मुश्किल लगता है। [I find it difficult to make sentences.] Speaker A: रोज प्रैक्टिस करेंगी तो आसान लगने लगेगा। [If you practice daily, it will start feeling easy.] Speaker B: किसके साथ प्रैक्टिस करूं? [With whom should I practice?] Speaker A: SpeakEasy app पर मेरे साथ। [With me on the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker B: आप कौन? [Who are you?] Speaker A: मैं AI English teacher वाणी। [I am AI English teacher Vaani.] Speaker B: अच्छा, मैं भी सीख सकती हूं? [Oh, can I learn too?] Speaker A: बिल्कुल। [Absolutely.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: An AI robot named Vaani helps a co-passenger on a train correct her English grammar. She introduces herself as an AI English teacher on the SpeakEasy app and invites the passenger to practice daily. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for fluent English.
